name: ai-playground-docs
description: Public developer & consumer docs for Picsart AI Playground: gen-ai CLI and MCP server reference.

scripts.build: npm run llms && npm run check:counts && npm run check:docs && npm run check:style && vitepress build
scripts.refresh:catalog: npm run export:catalog && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('.sdk-catalog.json', 'scripts/data/catalog.json')" && node scripts/build-catalog-data.mjs .sdk-catalog.json && node scripts/build-provider-pages.mjs .sdk-catalog.json && npm run fix:counts
